description:
Delete the temporary `GitRevisionResolver` bridge and the single-path pinned read that only it and tests use.

## Background

- `crates/jit/src/storage/git_revision.rs` holds only `GitRevisionResolver`, a bridge delegating to `GitCheckout`, and the `GitRevisionError` name, re-exported at `crates/jit/src/storage/mod.rs:58`. Storage, the archive planner and the behaviour suite use the module API directly.
- `GitCheckout::read_pinned_path` has no production caller once the archive planner reads through the object reader. Its return type `PinnedArtifactRead` (`crates/jit/src/storage/git_revision.rs:53`, re-exported at `crates/jit/src/storage/mod.rs:59`) has no other use. The module suite calls it in `test_git_revision_resolver_canonicalizes_symbolic_abbreviated_and_full_revisions` and `test_git_revision_resolver_never_falls_back_on_invalid_revision_or_failed_blob_read` (moved from `crates/jit/tests/fast_docs_templates/git_revision_tests.rs:64` and `crates/jit/tests/fast_docs_templates/git_revision_tests.rs:82`).

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: `storage/git_revision.rs`, `GitRevisionResolver`, the `GitRevisionError` name and their re-exports no longer exist.
- [hard] REQ-02: `GitCheckout::read_pinned_path` and its return type `PinnedArtifactRead` no longer exist, nor does the type's re-export. The two suite cases that call it keep their `resolve_commit` assertions and drop their pinned-path reads, whose unresolvable-revision and missing-path cases the object-reader cases own.

## Notes

- Written against the code as it stands after the changes this one follows; line citations name current code.
title: Remove the revision resolver bridge
